release_notes: V14.44 build 243 replaces the newer mini-trend parser with the exact proven B207 mini-trend request, parsing, fallback, FIFO refill and live-update implementation. The 1-hour mini trend now refills through the normal three-minute combined Nightscout backfill and continues with five-minute live FIFO updates. The shared 12-hour glucose RAM buffer and selectable 1-to-12-hour long-trend slices remain unchanged. This build retains the full Leah 2R Displays product feature set, configurable local alias, screen rotation, insulin and carbohydrate history, IOB and COB screens, read-only Nightscout ketone history, WhatsApp alerts, alarm acknowledgement, OTA protections, CPU-efficient trend maintenance, physical forced backfill and the protected full NVS factory reset.
